Subject: Quick compatibility check request before demo

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after my self-serve signup. We're interested in Redwood for serving a 1B-parameter model at the edge (latency-sensitive); before we schedule a full product demo, could we do a short 15-minute technical triage so I can confirm the high-level compatibility with our infra and the expected latency numbers?

High-level details: we run Kubernetes clusters in our AWS accounts, primarily us-west-2; models will be loaded from an internal OCI registry; we have strict egress controls. Happy to share an architecture diagram prior to the call.

Preferred window: Wed or Thu next week, morning PST.

Best,
Alex

Hi Alex — Ava here (Solutions Engineer). Thanks for the diagram — I did a quick pass and flagged two things we should touch on in the 15-min triage so we can avoid a follow-up:

1) OCI registry auth flow (we support short-lived tokens and private registries via IAM role assumption; need to confirm your registry supports token exchange)
2) VPC egress + NAT placement (we can run in customer VPC or through our Private package — want to confirm your preference)

Agenda I propose for the 15 minutes:
- 2 min quick intros
- 8 min key compatibility questions (registry auth, network, expected peak concurrency)
- 3 min next steps + whether to schedule a full demo and an infra deep-dive

Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/xyz-abcq-123 (Camila has calendar invite)

If anything else is sensitive, we can redact on the call. Looking forward to efficient timeboxing.

— Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
